scripts.build: node tools/extract-strings.mjs --check && python3 tools/verify_fonts.py && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node tools/boot-budget.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:desktop:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:desktop:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.yml --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:desktop:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.yml --linux dir --x64 --publish never
